command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes').name; foreach(`$n in `$nodes){ `$cc='display%20current-configuration'; `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cc; `$u0='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cc; `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1).output; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u0).output; if(`$a -like 'Error:*' -or `$b -like 'Error:*'){ `$cc='show%20running-config'; `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cc; `$u0='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$cc; `$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1).output; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u0).output }; if(`$a -notlike 'Error:*' -and `$b -notlike 'Error:*'){ `$aa=`$a -split '`r?`n' | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch 'Last configuration|Current configuration :' }; `$bb=`$b -split '`r?`n' | Where-Object { `$_ -and `$_ -notmatch 'Last configuration|Current configuration :' }; `$d=Compare-Object -ReferenceObject `$bb -DifferenceObject `$aa; if(`$d){ Write-Output ('===== '+`$n+' ====='); `$d | ForEach-Object { Write-Output (`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject) } } } }"
